message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data paths or parsed arguments before they are used.
No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads models and tokenizers via local paths/names without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication for remote sources.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset and data preparation code contain no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs; data is loaded and used as-is.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models and tokenizers via AutoModel and AutoTokenizer using a path/name argument without any hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled internal registry validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop performs only standard forward/backward passes with no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation enforcement of a held-out test set from training data, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and only a single metric (MCC via matthews_corrcoef) is referenced with no independent verification mechanisms.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes inputs directly to the model via the dataset and dataloader without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming requests.
No detected output bounds checks: The evaluate_step function returns raw logits and loss without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation on the model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text (CoLA dataset), it is a BERT-based classifier and not an LLM; no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is implemented.
